about: Palettes for the mock to try, drawn from the Nerrix design library (nerrix-digital/design-library/palettes, pulled from public dopely.colors and dyslove.design posts on 2026-10-26). Each gives the library's own hexes in five roles: dark (the anchor: night paper, day ink), brand (the day accent), bright (the night accent; derived from brand when absent), tint (soft surfaces), light (day paper; derived from the tint when absent). scripts/palettes.mjs derives the rest and checks the contrast. The last entry is the portal's Bugambilia, the current default, kept as the baseline to compare against.
